screenDefinitions.description: Curated slug/state manifest (required for canvas-export until full auto-catalog)

crawl.description: site-crawl options: seed paths, BFS depth/page limits, and allow/deny globs (see src/adapters/site-crawl/discover.ts SiteCrawlOptions)

seeds.description: Extra seed paths relative to the entry origin. Default: ["/"].

maxDepth.description: BFS depth limit; seed pages are depth 0. Default: 2.

maxPages.description: Safety cap on total fetch attempts for one crawl. Default: 500.

allowPatterns.description: If non-empty, only discovered links whose path matches at least one glob are followed/kept.

denyPatterns.description: Discovered links whose path matches any glob here are never followed/kept. Deny wins over allow.

baseUrl.description: Design ground truth origin (static reference server or live design URL)

stack.description: Optional free-form label for the target implementation's framework/language (e.g. "next-app-router", "vite", "rails", "django", "plain-html"). Not read by any command logic today — purely descriptive, so any string is accepted.

baseUrl.description: Implementation origin (dev server or production preview)

localePrefix.description: Optional locale segment prepended to catalog livePath during compare

routesFile.description: JSON manifest of implemented routes for replicate surplus

outputDir.description: Workspace-relative dir for catalog, routes, reference
